featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Vishal Sikka? The AI Pioneer Who Ran Infosys — and Just Raised $85 Million to Disrupt It
editorial.excerpt: Nine years after a bruising exit from Infosys, the 59-year-old former SAP CTO has founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that closed $85 million in seed funding in four months — with Intel and Micron's CEOs writing checks.
editorial.image_caption: Vishal Sikka speaking at SAP's SAPPHIRE conference in Orlando in 2010, when he was the company's first-ever CTO. In 2026 he founded Hang Ten Systems, an enterprise AI startup that has raised $85 million in seed funding.
editorial.nri_angle: Sikka's arc — small-town Madhya Pradesh to Stanford mentorship under AI's founding fathers to the top of Infosys and SAP, and now a founder again at 59 — embodies the Indian diaspora's outsize role in the AI era.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Nearly 1.9 Lakh Cancer Cases in India Tied to Infections, Lancet Study Finds
just_in.excerpt: A Lancet study estimates infections caused nearly 1.9 lakh of India's new cancer cases in 2024, led by HPV-linked cervical cancer, highlighting the role of vaccination and screening in prevention.
just_in.image_caption: Researchers study infection-linked cancers in a laboratory
just_in.nri_angle: For the diaspora, the study is a reminder that cancer-prevention norms differ by geography: many countries offer HPV vaccination to adolescents and routine HPV screening to adult women as standard care, and NRIs traveling with or caring for family in India can help close the gap by encouraging both.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: One in Three Indian Employees in Their 30s Has Elevated Blood Sugar
just_in.excerpt: Loop Health's Workforce Health Index 2026, built on 816,000+ lab values, found blood-sugar dysfunction rising from 16.7% in employees' 20s to 52.9% in their 40s — with most people unaware anything is wrong.
just_in.image_caption: A blood glucose meter used to test blood sugar levels
just_in.nri_angle: South Asians face elevated diabetes risk at lower body weights, so an annual HbA1c check in the 30s is a sensible baseline — and diaspora readers can nudge family in India in precisely the urban-workforce cohort this report covers.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Indore Clinic Launches Madhya Pradesh's First Alzheimer's Blood Biomarker Test
just_in.excerpt: Sampurna Sodani Diagnostic Clinic in Indore says its new pTau217 and Aβ42 blood test can flag Alzheimer's-related brain changes 10 to 15 years before symptoms, offering a less invasive alternative to spinal taps and PET scans.
just_in.image_caption: An illustration depicts an elderly man with a puzzle-piece brain graphic labeled Alzheimer's Disease. Sampurna Sodani Diagnostic Clinic in Indore says its new pTau217 and A-beta-42 blood biomarker test can flag Alzheimer's-related brain changes 10 to 15 years before symptoms appear.
just_in.nri_angle: For diaspora families with aging parents in India, the test adds a concrete option for elder-care planning back home: a blood-based screening in a tier-2 city can give NRIs coordinating care from abroad an earlier, clearer picture of a parent's cognitive health without requiring travel to a metro hospital.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: After 20 Miscarriages Over a Decade, Chicago Mom Celebrates Son's First Birthday
just_in.excerpt: Ranim Haddad, 36, of Alsip, Illinois, endured at least 20 pregnancy losses with husband Fuad before conceiving naturally in 2020 — and marked the milestone on October 1, the start of Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month.
just_in.image_caption: A mother holds her newborn; a Chicago mom is celebrating her son's milestone after a decade-long fertility journey
just_in.nri_angle: Recurrent pregnancy loss is a subject many South Asian families also face in silence, where cultural pressure around having children can make fertility struggles especially isolating — the Haddads' openness gives other families permission to name their own losses.
tags: Pregnancy and Infant Loss Awareness Month
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Wanderers to Host 2027 World Cup Final and India–Pakistan Clash
just_in.excerpt: The ICC has released the 2027 men's ODI World Cup schedule, with Johannesburg's Wanderers hosting both the India–Pakistan clash on October 10 and the final on November 21, and an official ticket ballot now open.
just_in.image_caption: The Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg, set to host the 2027 World Cup final
just_in.nri_angle: The ICC's official ticket ballot, open from October 1 until November 21, gives diaspora fans in North America, the UK and the Gulf a fair, non-first-come-first-served shot at seats for the India–Pakistan game and the final at the Wanderers.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Vaping Harms the Heart Too, Not Just the Lungs, Doctors Warn
just_in.excerpt: Growing research shows e-cigarettes expose users to chemicals that damage blood vessels and disrupt heart rhythm — and a new expert consensus says no nicotine product is safe for the heart.
just_in.image_caption: An electronic cigarette; doctors warn vaping harms the heart as well as the lungs
just_in.nri_angle: Vaping remains widely available to young people despite India's 2019 ban, and diaspora families in the US and UK face aggressive youth marketing of flavored vapes — doctors advise parents to treat vaping as a genuine cardiovascular risk, not a phase.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Middle East Oil Exports Rebound to Near Pre-War Levels as Crude Prices Stay Volatile
just_in.excerpt: Crude flows from the Gulf have recovered to about 98% of pre-war levels through overland pipelines and ship-to-ship transfers, but Brent prices remain volatile near $97–102 as tanker attacks continue and the U.S. sends a third carrier group to the region.
just_in.image_caption: An illustration shows oil barrels and a pump jack at sunset. Crude exports from the Gulf have rebounded to about 98% of pre-war levels through overland pipelines and ship-to-ship transfers, though Brent prices remain volatile near $97-102 a barrel as tanker attacks continue.
just_in.nri_angle: The Gulf's crude matters directly to India, which imports the bulk of its oil from the region: a sustained export recovery would ease India's import bill and take pressure off fuel prices and the rupee, while any renewed disruption hits Indian households and the government's finances first.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Putin Says PM Modi Has 'Very Good Ideas' for Ending Ukraine Conflict
just_in.excerpt: The Russian president, speaking at the Valdai International Discussion Club, said Modi raises the issue of ending the war at every meeting and that Moscow is thankful for India's push for a peaceful settlement.
just_in.image_caption: Russian President Vladimir Putin shakes hands with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, both smiling, at a recent meeting. Putin praised Modi's "very good ideas" for a mutually acceptable settlement of the Ukraine conflict at the Valdai International Discussion Club on October 1.
just_in.nri_angle: The diaspora has watched India's balancing act since 2022 — from student evacuations in Ukraine to energy-price ripples — and Putin's public praise will be read as validation of India's growing diplomatic weight.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Journalist Among Eight Palestinians Killed in Israeli Attacks on Gaza
just_in.excerpt: Palestinian journalist Muhammad Abdel Aziz al-Najjar, the 263rd media worker killed since October 2023, died as Israeli strikes hit a Gaza City van, an apartment, and a displaced-persons shelter amid continued ceasefire violations.
just_in.nri_angle: India's large media community and diaspora follow Gaza's journalist death toll closely; Indian press-freedom advocates have demanded international accountability for the killing of media workers.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Second US Judge Blocks Trump's $100,000 H-1B Fee in Oakland Ruling
just_in.excerpt: Judge Haywood Gilliam ruled USCIS and the State Department skipped required rulemaking before imposing the fee, granting unions and employers a block while their lawsuit proceeds — the second such defeat after Boston's June ruling.
just_in.nri_angle: Indians are the largest H-1B recipients, so a second judicial block on the $100,000 fee directly protects Indian professionals and employers — though the push for a permanent $103,000 fee means uncertainty persists.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon, Its Most Powerful AI Model Yet
just_in.excerpt: The first Gemini 4 model targets long, multi-step engineering and cybersecurity work, leads on 13 of 18 benchmarks by Google's count, and rolls out first to trusted cyber defenders — with broader access to follow.
just_in.image_caption: The Googleplex, Google's headquarters in Mountain View, California
just_in.nri_angle: Google CEO Sundar Pichai's Gemini 4 Argon launch is a defining test for the Tamil Nadu-born chief executive — and for the vast Indian engineering workforce that powers Google's AI ambitions.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1 Is Now Titled 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend'
just_in.excerpt: Sony Pictures announced the official title on September 28 with a new poster, confirming a worldwide IMAX 3D release on November 6, 2026, in Hindi and English under the tagline "Mankind's greatest story comes to life."
just_in.image_caption: The official poster for "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend" shows Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama holding a bow opposite Yash's Ravana against a cosmic backdrop. Sony Pictures announced the title and a worldwide IMAX 3D release on November 6, 2026, under the tagline "Mankind's greatest story comes to life."
just_in.nri_angle: The film is explicitly engineered for a global audience — English version, worldwide IMAX rollout, Sony's international distribution — putting diaspora audiences in Los Angeles, London, Toronto and Sydney at the center of its release plan.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: 'They'll Be Hit Very Hard': Trump Sends 9,000 Troops to Middle East After Warning Iran
just_in.excerpt: The Pentagon is dispatching roughly 9,000 troops aboard ships to the Middle East as President Trump warns of retaliation against Iran over a suspected link to the FlyDubai co-pilot who attacked a captain on an Israel-bound flight.
just_in.image_caption: President Donald Trump speaks to reporters on the White House lawn on October 1, 2026. Trump warned Iran that they'll be hit very hard if a link is established between Tehran and the FlyDubai co-pilot who attacked a captain on an Israel-bound flight.
just_in.nri_angle: With a large Indian diaspora across the Gulf, including many aviation and maritime workers, a potential US-Iran escalation puts real people — not just markets — at risk, hitting daily life and livelihoods first.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Drishyam 3 Sells 4.05 Lakh Tickets in Advance, 7th-Biggest Pre-Sale Ever
just_in.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam: The Conclusion has sold around 4.05 lakh opening-day tickets in PVR Inox and Cinepolis, ranking 7th all-time and second in 2026, with trade forecasting a Rs. 50 crore opening on Gandhi Jayanti.
just_in.image_caption: Official poster artwork for Drishyam: The Conclusion, featuring Ajay Devgn (center) and Tabu (right). The film sold around 4.05 lakh opening-day tickets across PVR Inox and Cinepolis, the 7th-biggest advance sale in Bollywood history, ahead of its October 2 release.
just_in.nri_angle: The Drishyam franchise has always traveled well with the Indian diaspora, and overseas screens in North America, the UK and the Middle East open alongside the Indian release, giving diaspora audiences a record-breaking reason to catch the finale in theaters.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: AI Pricing Pressure and Cautious Clients Cloud Indian IT's September Quarter Earnings
just_in.excerpt: Five brokerages tell Reuters that India's top IT firms face their weakest sequential quarter in three years as AI-driven price deflation eats into the billable-hours model; guidance cuts loom when TCS reports October 8.
just_in.image_caption: A data card from analyst Aravind Raghunathan shows the Jefferies forecast of 0.7% to 3.5% quarter-on-quarter revenue growth for India's top six IT firms. The figure would mark the sector's weakest sequential performance in three years as AI-driven pricing pressure and cautious client spending weigh on September-quarter earnings.
just_in.nri_angle: India's IT sector anchors diaspora jobs, visa-linked postings, and NRI investment; its forced pivot from billable hours to AI-driven outcomes reshapes prospects for Indian tech professionals at home and abroad.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nike Stock Plunges 8.5% After Revenue Miss, Steep Forecast Cut and Job-Cut Plan
markets-finance.excerpt: Nike reported $11.21 billion in quarterly revenue, below Wall Street estimates, and warned full-year revenue will decline by a high single-digit percentage — unveiling a 'Pace' restructuring with job cuts and a new India campus.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Nike swoosh logo displayed at a company store. Nike shares fell 8.5% in extended trading after the company missed revenue estimates and warned full-year revenue would decline by a high single-digit percentage.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Nike's planned new India campus — framed as offering "strong capabilities and access to talent" — positions India as the brand's next hub for design, engineering and supply-chain talent even as it cuts roles elsewhere.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Fed's Jefferson Flags High Inflation, Urges Patience on October Rate Decision
markets-finance.excerpt: In a Thursday speech at the University of Virginia, Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said inflation has run above the 2% target for more than five years, even as he signaled officials may hold rates at the October 27–28 meeting to assess incoming data.
markets-finance.image_caption: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson
markets-finance.nri_angle: A Fed hold is practical news for Indian diaspora households in the United States: it takes pressure off mortgage rates and dollar savings, while investors with stakes in Indian equities and the rupee benefit from less capital-flight pressure each time a U.S. hike is deferred.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Lovlina Borgohain Wins Gold on Her Birthday as India Powers Through Day 14
sports.excerpt: On her 29th birthday, Lovlina Borgohain beat China's Bao Ziyi 5-0 to win 75kg boxing gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games — while India's women's recurve team stunned South Korea for a historic first gold and Sujeet Kalkal reached the 65kg wrestling final.
sports.image_caption: Lovlina Borgohain celebrates after winning the women's 75kg boxing gold at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on October 2, 2026. The 29-year-old defeated China's Bao Ziyi 5-0 on her birthday, becoming only the second Indian woman after Mary Kom to win Asian Games boxing gold.
sports.nri_angle: Lovlina's birthday gold and the teenage heroics of Kumkum Mohod will resonate with diaspora audiences, who consistently engage most strongly with these landmark Indian sporting moments.

entertainment.image_caption: YouTuber MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) poses in a black jacket against a promotional backdrop. The world's most-subscribed YouTuber attended a September 26 "Ramayana: Part 1" event in Mumbai alongside Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and the film's team.
